thread:
maria: rolling out release/2026-03-routing today in the 22:00-22:30 change window. This includes ff:enable 'new-routing-v2' with a warmup ramp and automatic cutoff. planning to start 22:05 UTC.

kevin: noted. what's the ramp plan?

maria: plan: 1) 0% -> 2% at t+5m, 2) 2% -> 10% at t+10m, 3) 10% -> 50% at t+20m, 4) 50% -> 100% at t+40m. total ~45m. will abort if any safety triggers.

raj: add an early hold at 10% if p95 latency > 500ms or error rate delta > 0.5%. also circuit-break to rollback to pinned-2026-03-19 if capacity pressure spikes.

maria: yep. safety triggers:
```
- p95 > 500ms (5m rolling)
- error_rate increase > 0.5ppt vs baseline (5m rolling)
- HTTP 5xx spike > 100 rps sustained 1m
- token backlog queue > 2000 for >2m
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued: release/2026-03-routing -> starting canary canary-id=cb-1705123456. Canary hosts: gpu-a1,gpu-a2. ff change: new-routing-v2=2%

kevin: monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/inbox/alerts/2387 and the perf dashboard for model-routing. i'll watch send logs to #eng-oncall.

ops-bot: notice: quota headroom for Dedicated pool at 22:00 = 18% available. will auto-burst up to 30% on detected queue growth.

sophie: small request: enable sticky session pin for 2% cohort to avoid cold-start noise during the 2% stage. we can unpin on 10% stage.

maria: ok will pin cohort @2% then unpin at 10% threshold. adding rollout note to release: https://go/release/2026-03-routing/notes

jordan: rollback plan? who clicks the final abort?

maria: if any of the safety triggers fire, deploy-bot will auto-cutoff and set ff back to previous variant. if we see persistent issues beyond 10 mins after cutoff, ops team will execute manual rollback to pinned-2026-03-19. escalation: @kevin -> @raj -> oncall.

kevin: will run a preflight smoke at t-5m (simple 10 requests validating routing output signature + latency < 200ms).

raj: adding a temporary telemetry eval that will run 200 requests through the 2% cohort and compare token-level regressions. if regression_score > 0.02 revert.

maria: deployed canary started. watch for deploy-bot updates. tagging this thread for postmortem notes if anything odd. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary update: new-routing-v2=2% applied. health: OK. p95=120ms, errors=0.02%

kevin: looks good so far. proceeding to 10% at +10m unless alerts. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: automatic warmup timer set. will post at each step and on cutoff.

maria: thanks everyone. will post final rollforward confirmation once at 100%.
